name: cam_plate
description: Cam plate, 12 mm thick, outer profile a smooth closed spline cam lobe (no tangent breaks) with a D24 bore and a 6 wide keyway to R16.5, a hexagonal recess (30 mm across flats, 5 deep, R2 corners) around the bore, three kidney-shaped through windows (R1.9 corners), and a 1 mm x 45deg chamfer on the bore edge at the hex recess floor.
